data.brand_promise: Give fashion shoppers a more considered visual starting point on the Shopify product page.
data.headline: Let shoppers see the fit before they buy.
data.value_proposition: Fitcheck is AI Fit Confidence for Shopify: a product-page visual try-on experience for fashion merchants who want a guided way to explore shopper fit confidence without promising commercial or sizing outcomes.

elevator_pitch.full: Fashion merchants know that static product imagery can leave a shopper's personal fit question unresolved. Fitcheck is an AI fit-confidence experience for Shopify that adds a visual try-on moment to the product page. Unlike a custom, open-ended project or a generic novelty widget, it offers a guided rollout and merchant-specific learning. Fitcheck is listed in the Shopify App Store; outcomes must be measured in each merchant's own context.

components.problem: Product imagery may not resolve a shopper's personal fit question.
components.solution: A visual try-on moment on the Shopify product page.
components.proof: Public Shopify App Store distribution presence.

key_messages.headline: Give shoppers a more considered visual starting point
proof_points: Do not represent try-on as sizing certainty.

key_messages.headline: Start with a bounded merchant rollout
proof_points: Treat outcomes as hypotheses until measured.

key_messages.headline: Keep the experience clear, editorial, and transparent
proof_points: Avoid competitor language and unsupported claims.
